title: TUI editing and save safety
summary: The current typed editing loop, including cancel, validation, guarded deletion, dirty state, saving, export, and failure retention.
implementationStatus: Observed for controlled-choice editing and broadly covered by shipped tests and demonstrations.

webDesign: Use accessible typed controls and the same application-owned mutation and persistence result contracts.
